keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Villarreal 0, Paris Saint Germain 1. João Neves (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from very close range to the top right corner following a corner.
Goal! Villarreal 0, Paris Saint Germain 2. Désiré Doué (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Maghnes Akliouche.
Goal! Villarreal 0, Paris Saint Germain 3. Senny Mayulu (Paris Saint Germain) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner.
Goal! Villarreal 0, Paris Saint Germain 4. Fabián Ruiz (Paris Saint Germain) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Maghnes Akliouche.
Santi Comesaña (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Villarreal 0, Paris Saint Germain 4.
Substitution, Villarreal. Sergi Cardona replaces Nicolas Pepe.
Santiago Mouriño (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Villarreal 0, Paris Saint Germain 5. Fabián Ruiz (Paris Saint Germain) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Vitinha following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Mika Godts replaces Senny Mayulu.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Ferran Torres replaces Maghnes Akliouche.
Substitution, Villarreal. Tani Oluwaseyi replaces Carlos Romero.
Substitution, Villarreal. Georges Mikautadze replaces Ayoze Pérez.
Substitution, Villarreal. Alberto Moleiro replaces Santi Comesaña.
Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. David Boly replaces Achraf Hakimi.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Quentin Ndjantou replaces Désiré Doué.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Beraldo replaces Vitinha.
Quentin Ndjantou (Paris Saint Germain) is shown the yellow card.
Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Villarreal 0, Paris Saint Germain 6. David Boly (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by João Neves.
Substitution, Villarreal. Pau Navarro replaces Alex Freeman.
